entities.summary: Sean Lee Smith is an American former professional football player who was a cornerback in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Utah Utes and was selected by the Miami Dolphins in the second round of the 2009 NFL draft. He also played for the Kansas City Chiefs and Oakland Raiders.
